source: Not a book section. The one-game-across-modules shape follows CodeHS's project modules in Introduction to Game Design and AP CSA's class units. Structure only: no CodeHS text, problems or code is copied.

lessons.title: Plan, a ship, and shots on a cooldown
lessons.objective: Students will be able to plan a game as parts and remembered values, keep a sprite on the canvas with two ifs, and rate-limit firing with a cooldown they start themselves.

lessons.title: Did the shot hit?
lessons.objective: Students will be able to test two pass-through sprites with overlaps(), and remove a shot from the screen and the array on the frame it hits.

lessons.title: A round: hp, game over and restart
lessons.objective: Students will be able to give the base hp that a landing costs, end the round at 0, and start a new round that puts back everything the round owns.
